🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Fall Out Boy announce Twilight of the Punks tour for 2027

Fall Out Boy have confirmed a 15-date European and UK run for 2027 as part of their 25th anniversary tour, opening in Prague on 17 May and closing in Lodz on 13 June. Two stops are in Germany: Mönchengladbach on 28 May and Berlin on 12 June. A Day To Remember and Neck Deep are named as support.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Waterparks and Basement added to Download Festival 2027

Waterparks and Basement are on the first-wave lineup for Download Festival 2027, which takes place from 9 to 13 June at Donington Park in the UK. blink-182, Bring Me The Horizon and Evanescence are named as headliners.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: ITCHY continue 25 Years tour into January 2027

ITCHY mark 25 years as a band with an extended anniversary run. The remaining dates start in Salzburg on 19 November 2026 and include seven German shows, among them Hamburg on 3 December and Berlin on 5 December. The tour ends in Stuttgart on 16 January 2027.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Papa Roach play five more German arenas in November

The Rise Of The Roach arena tour has five German dates left, from Berlin on 18 November to Frankfurt on 26 November, with Hamburg, Cologne and Leipzig in between. Landmvrks and Sleep Theory are the confirmed support acts.
